name: Mellow · Gremlet #47
description:
A manatee calf that drifts wherever the current goes and greets everyone with a gentle bump.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Mellow in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
